name: Houston Washburn
tagline: Top rated Criminal Defense attorney in Milton, Georgia
about: Attorney Houston Washburn is the founder and owner of Houston Washburn Law with offices in Milton and Lawrenceville, Georgia. As a top-rated and highly versatile trial lawyer, Mr. Washburn provides unmatched counsel, advocacy and support to a diverse range of clients throughout the State of Georgia who have legal needs involving any of the following:

In addition, Mr. Washburn has extensive experience with family law and general civil litigation. No matter the legal challenges affecting his clients' lives, he provides personalized counsel to help them make the best-informed decisions as he aggressively pursues the most favorable outcomes on their behalf both inside and outside of the courtroom. From his efforts, he has achieved a long record of securing acquittals, dismissals and reductions of charges for the accused, and he has obtained substantial settlements and verdicts for his plaintiff injury clients.

Honored for his outstanding professionalism, Mr. Washburn has earned consistent top rankings and endorsements from his peers, and he has established himself as an emerging leader in his field. Recognized for his superior client service, he has received numerous testimonials and referrals from those he has served, and he finds great reward in being able to help so many in his area during their times of dire need.

A 2011 graduate of the University of Georgia, Mr. Washburn attended John Marshall Law School in Atlanta, where he obtained his Juris Doctor in 2014. He is admitted to practice before all Georgia state courts as well as before the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Georgia, the Georgia Court of Appeals and the Georgia Supreme Court.

Active in his legal community, Mr. Washburn is a member of the State Bar of Georgia and the Gwinnett Bar Association. He is also a member of the National College for DUI Defense, Georgia Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers, and the Georgia Trial Lawyers Association.
